units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52">Gen. R. s. 52</cite>, beg. (expl. <he>יעתק</he>, <cite ref="Job 14:18">Job XIV, 18</cite>) <he>פנה ממקומו</he> he (Abraham) moved from where he was; Yalk. ib. 87; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 906:25">Yalk. Job 906</cite>.

senses.gloss: to remove, transfer. Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᶜ top (ref. to Ps. XXXI, 19 הדוברות … עתק) הדוברות על צדיקי של עולם דברים שה׳ מבריותיו who speak concerning the Righteous One of the world words which he has withheld from his creatures (esoteric philosophy); Yalk. Ps. 715; Gen. R. s. 1 שה׳ בבריותיו (corr. acc., v. ‘Rashi’ a. l.).
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Chronicles 4:22">I Chr. IV, 22</cite>) <he>דברים הללו נאמרו ממַעְתִּיקוֹ של עולם וכ׳</he> these words were spoken by Him who moves the world (by ref. to <he>ויעתק</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 12:8">Gen. XII, 8</cite>); (Yalk. Chr. 1074 <he>דברים הללו מעתיקו</he>, v. <cite ref="P01532"><he>עַתִּיק</he></cite>).
Yalk. Prov. 961 (ref. to העתיקו, Prov. XXV, 1) העתיקו מלמד שגנוזים היו ‘hʿetiḳu’ (they removed), this shows that they were suppressed (v. גָּנַז).

Ib. דבר אחר אין העתיקו אלא פירשו וכ׳ another interpretation is, hʿetiḳu means ‘they set aside’ (ref. to Gen. XII, 8), i.e. translated, interpreted (v. פָּרַשׁ, a. cmp. the later use of העתיק to edit, to translate); Ab. d’R. N. ch. I, 2ⁿᵈ Vers. (ed. Schechter, p. 3) אין העתיקו אלא שפרשו; ib. 1ˢᵗ Vers. לא שהמתינו אלא שפירשו, v. next w.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:8:1">Koh. R. to I, 8</cite> (in enigmatic speech) <he>ואני הוּעְתַּקְתִּי לכאן להחיש מחיה</he> and I have come here to accelerate the growth (of hair).

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah, Petichta 11">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>הנֶעְתָּקִין</he>, v. <cite ref="S01050"><he>קִינְסִין</he></cite>. Yalk. Chr. 1076 (ref. to I Chr. l. c.) <he>אפי׳ … שנִתְעַתְּקוּ מהם החזירם</he> even things which had been removed from them (esoteric thoughts) did he bring back; Ruth R. l. c. (not <he>שנתעסקו</he>).
